name: Wilderness Trace Solar
old_description: Located in Danville, KY. Wilderness Trace Solar specializes in solar panel installation and solar panel maintenance. 5-Year workmanship warranty. Free estimates. Transparency and trustworthiness. Call today and request a quote.
about:
Wilderness Trace Solar was founded in 2015 in Danville, Kentucky, and serves residential, commercial, agricultural, and municipal customers across Central and Eastern Kentucky. The company is locally owned and operates from a facility that includes a warehouse stocked with solar panels, inverters, racking, and mounting hardware for both installed systems and do-it-yourself purchases.

The business provides turn-key solar energy solutions, handling system design, permitting, installation, and ongoing maintenance. Its technicians carry OSHA 10 and NABCEP certifications, and the company is a member of the Kentucky Solar Energy Industries Association (KYSEIA). In addition to installation services, Wilderness Trace Solar sells equipment from brands such as Emmvee, SolarEdge, SMA Solar Technology, APsystems, SnapNrack, Powers Solar Frames, and SIGMATEK. The team emphasizes a 5-year workmanship warranty and passes through manufacturer warranties on all components.

Customers include homeowners seeking to reduce electricity bills, farms and agri-businesses aiming to lower operational costs, and commercial or industrial facilities looking to cut energy expenses while meeting sustainability goals. The company also works with municipal projects and assists clients with federal investment tax credits (ITC) and the generation and sale of solar renewable energy certificates (SRECs).

Wilderness Trace Solar differentiates itself through a transparent, relationship-focused approach that includes free estimates, a single point of contact for the entire project, and guidance on available tax incentives. The firm’s combined staff experience exceeds 20 years, and it promotes its certifications and association membership as markers of professional accountability.
